Definition: properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed)
BiblicalUsage: From Egypt the king of the north carries captive the gods with their molten images and precious vessels of silver and gold, and Moses asks where the gods are who drank the wine of their drink offerings.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that idols are carried off like luggage: the gods of Egypt go into captivity with their vessels, and Moses' question stands — where are they when their people need them?
